description: $0.025 per call. Solana token safety card for ONE token. Use when you need every measured field: holders (count, top-5 share, HHI, create-slot bundle, insider and creator shares), rug and close flags with first-seen times, curve truth (graduation = curve witnessed >= 84 SOL), demand, exit signals, the creator's record at launch, P(rug within 5 min) for young mints, P(true graduation), market, authorities and, on a full card, the cohorts block with the holders' reputation across tokens. coverage full = in our live window; thin = any other SPL mint: launch record if any, current curve state, mint and freeze authority and the Token-2022 extensions that let someone seize, block or tax holders. Always answers for a valid base58 mint. Quick pre-trade check: check_pumpfun_risk ($0.005). Input: mint (a mint or a pump.fun/gmgn/solscan/birdeye link). Nulls carry a reason; nothing is guessed. A stale feed is refused before payment.

mint.description: base58 SPL mint address (32-44 chars); pump.fun mints usually end in 'pump'. Accepts a mint or a pump.fun/gmgn/solscan/birdeye link.
